top_categories.workout_context: 6,562ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
77ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Granfondo Colombia's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.

UCI Granfondo Colombia's mountain rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 85 miles.
At UCI Granfondo Colombia, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Granfondo Colombia. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 85 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
6,562ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at UCI Granfondo Colombia. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mountain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for UCI Granfondo Colombia’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: UCI Granfondo Colombia reaches approximately 8,300ft above sea level. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at UCI Granfondo Colombia rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 85 miles of mountain in Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia.
